# WebAtlas

> WebAtlas is a functional web studio in Casablanca, Morocco. We build custom business websites — booking engines, lead capture systems, client portals, B2B catalogs, and direct reservation flows — delivered in 10 days with fixed pricing from $800. English, French, and Arabic supported.

- Location: Casablanca, Morocco (global remote delivery)
- Contact: hello@webatlas.xyz
- Pricing: Fixed project quotes from $800 to $2,800 (no hourly billing)
- Delivery: Live preview by day 3, production launch by day 10
- Markets: Morocco, France, Belgium, UK, Qatar, UAE, Senegal, Switzerland, Singapore, Canada

## Services

- [Custom Web Applications](https://webatlas.xyz/services#custom): Tailored web apps for any business workflow
- [Booking Engine](https://webatlas.xyz/services#booking): Online appointment systems for clinics, salons, consultants ($1,200–$2,200)
- [Lead Capture Site](https://webatlas.xyz/services#leadgen): Conversion-optimized sites for real estate, contractors, advisors ($800–$1,400)
- [Client Portal](https://webatlas.xyz/services#portal): Secure document and project hubs for professional firms ($1,500–$2,800)
- [B2B Product Catalog](https://webatlas.xyz/services#catalog): Searchable catalogs with RFQ for manufacturers and exporters ($1,100–$2,000)
- [Direct Reservation System](https://webatlas.xyz/services#reservation): Bypass OTA commissions for riads, restaurants, tour operators ($900–$1,800)
- [Multilingual Trust Site](https://webatlas.xyz/services#multilang): French, English, Arabic with hreflang SEO and RTL support ($1,000–$2,000)
